releaseNotes: Fixes a crash that closed the app when opening the IT, Audit, TDS, Other or Certificate fee pages, the dashboard drill-down into GST loading a blank financial year, the GST fees tab showing for clients with no GST work, and the IT/Audit filing detail dialog's Fetch button offering placeholder values instead of real portal data. Adds GST bulk fetch without portal login, a client-wise summary on the bulk update grid, and multi-select in chat.
